 Print The wedding celebration of film music composer Anirudh Ravichander and his bride Kavya Maran has started creating quite a stir because popular faces from the film industry, the political circle, and the business world are likely to attend. The wedding, which has already become the most talked about in the state, is likely to see the biggest stars of the state congregating in one place. While the ceremony is set to take place in Greece, preparations for the celebrations have also created considerable buzz among fans and the film fraternity. Rajinikanth and family, MK Stalin and Udhayanidhi travel to Greece
 Adding to the excitement, Superstar Rajinikanth and his family are reportedly heading to Greece to attend Anirudh and Kavya Maran's wedding. Former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin, his wife Durga Stalin, and Udhayanidhi Stalin have also travelled to Greece for the celebrations. Videos of Stalin and Udhayanidhi leaving for Greece have gone viral on social media. Stalin wore a formal outfit, while Udhayanidhi kept it casual. Their travel videos have sparked excitement among fans, particularly as several leading personalities are expected to be part of the wedding festivities. Four private jets arranged for guests
 The wedding is expected to be an intimate affair in Greece, with close family members and friends attending the ceremony. According to Filmibeat, arrangements have already been made for four private aircraft to fly to the wedding venue. Kavya Maran is the daughter of Sun Group chairman, Kalanithi Maran. She is also the CEO of the Sunrisers Hyderabad team. Anirudh, on the other hand, has been connected with the Sun Pictures banner through films like 'Beast,' 'Jailer,' 'Coolie' and 'Jailer 2. ' Anirudh and Kavya Maran's Chennai reception expected to be a star-studded affair
 While the wedding will take place in Greece, the celebrations are expected to continue in Chennai with a grand reception on November 21. Several prominent personalities from the film industry, politics, and business circles are expected to attend the event. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay, actors Nayanthara and Dhanush are among the names being discussed as possible guests. Now that it is known that Rajinikanth, political figures, and many other celebrities will join the celebration, everyone is waiting for Anirudh's wedding ceremony.
